storyCards.headline: Da' Dip: A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
Freak Nasty's "Da' Dip" reached #15 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #15 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 33 weeks on the chart.

Da' Dip was released in 1997.
